changes.description: Only package.json is modified: private; automatic prepack/prebuild/pretypecheck/pretest removed; exact semver/zod pins; modification notice. Every original source/test/fixture/script file is unchanged.

additions.description: Workbench-added standalone emit configuration. The original upstream tsconfig remains unchanged. Selects transport entry points and their dependency closure, uses ES2023/NodeNext with declaration emission, and does not activate upstream lifecycle scripts or compile the full SDK facade.

integration.generatedArtifacts: Existing selective standalone emit outputs and the Workbench-added compile configuration are recorded in generatedArtifacts. Initial source import did not execute a build; integration produced these outputs separately.
integration.applicationProtocol: Original protected channel and server_info schema; Workbench device admission/RPC remains a separate adapter. Full Paseo DaemonClient application protocol is not implemented by Workbench.
integration.sourceOnlyModules: Whole client/protocol copies preserve future dependencies and tests. Integration emits only the needed entry closure; upstream generated AOT validators are absent from the pinned archive and are not needed by the transport entry.
integration.runtimeSource: Every original runtime source file is byte-exact upstream. Only the selected schema/transport dependency closure is emitted; unconnected SDK modules remain source-only.

hashScope: SHA-256 over original/adapted source bytes, local additions, compile configuration and current generated artifacts. Excludes this source.json itself and node_modules; runtime dependency licenses are separately recorded in third_party/paseo/dependencies.json.

generatedArtifacts.treeHashEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 sorted package-relative path + NUL + file SHA-256 hex + LF.
generatedArtifacts.scope: Selected original transport/protocol and plugin label/requirement entry points and their imported dependency closure. Full DaemonClient/AOT facade remains unconnected.
generatedArtifacts.provenanceUpdate: U23 selected emit adds branch-slug, agent-labels and plugin-requirements; no original protocol source changes.

distribution.note: Paths in files/additions/generatedArtifacts are relative to pathBase, not the flat distribution copy.
